: block sodium/chloride reabsorption in thick ascending loop of Henle by interfering w/ chloride-binding co-transport system, ⇡ excretion of Na, K, Cl, Mg, Ca, & H2O, ⇣  blood volume (decreases congestion/edema)
used to relieve sxs related to congestion/edema
, increased TG/total cholesterol, orthostatic hypotension, photosensitivity, increased urination
: hydralazine is a direct arterial vasodilator (⇣ afterload), nitrates ⇡ NO availability which causes venous vasodilation (⇣ preload)
(not as much as ACEI/ARB); indicated for pts who cannot tolerate an ACEI/ARB d/t poor renal function, HX of angioedema, or hyperkalemia;
black pts w/ Class III-IV HF who are still symptomatic despite optimal tx w/ ACEIs/BBs
» Hydralazine: HA, reflex tachycardia, palpitations, fluid retention,
» Nitrates: HA, dizziness, lightheadedness, flushing, hypotension,
: inhibits Na/K ATPase pump resulting in ⇡ CO (⊕inotrope); exerts parasympathetic effect at AV node which ⇣ HR (⊖chronotropy)
: ⊘mortality benefit, but ⇣ hospitalizations; improves SXS, exercise tolerance, & QOL; pts who remain symptomatic despite optimal tx w/ ACEI/ARB & BB
: hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide gated channel blocker (HCN-blocker); inhibits “funny channels” in SA node, ⇣ sinus rate which ⇣ HR
: ⊘mortality benefit, but ⇣ hospitalizations; class II-III HF, LVEF ≤35%, sinus rhythm w/ resting HR ≥70bpm; either on maximally tolerated BB dose or have CI to BB
» Contraindications: ADHF, BP <90/50, pacemaker dependence, resting
: bradycardia, HTN, AFIB, luminous phenomena (seeing flashes of light)
through effects on ⇣ preload &/or afterload; may be used in addition to diuretics for rapid improvement of congestive sxs, to ⇣ dyspnea, & to improve peripheral oxygen delivery
» NTG: hypotension, HA, lightheadedness, tachycardia, tachyphylaxis
» Nitroprusside: hypotension, HA, tachycardia, cyanide toxicity
(class III/IV); suggest use for SXS relief & end-organ function improvement in pts w/ low SBP/CO
» Dobutamine: BP changes, ventricular arrythmias, tachycardia, angina
